items.text: Fully replace the Central Pro software currently in use, so DCS can use supported, modern software to generate forms, as the first step towards modernization of the forms generation system.
Replace Adobe Output Designer and Adobe Form Designer, the software currently used to design and develop forms, with functionality available in the AEM product.

Work with agency staff to convert all existing XFT files (approximately 300), hosted by a Visual Basic screen in the FormsGen section of SEMS, to the AEM format, actively training agency staff on conversion and development of forms in the AEM environment.

Develop online forms for customers and businesses; the first is the application for services form used to open a child support case, including a portal used by customers to access the application, storage and transmittal of application data, and integration into the SEMS application.

Work within the Adobe-managed hosting environment for AEM (AWS Government Cloud, FedRAMP compliance), with Secure Access Washington (SAW) authenticating external users and Active Directory authenticating internal users.
Include 200 hours of training in the bid, with the option for DSHS to purchase additional training at the rate provided.

Full replacement of Central Pro software: AEM integrated into SEMS, providing similar functional processes, products and outcomes, including conversion of existing forms and form templates to formats used by AEM, and replacement of Adobe Output Designer and Adobe Form Designer with AEM functionality.
Work with agency staff to convert approximately 300 XFT files hosted by the Visual Basic FormsGen screen in the SEMS application to the AEM format with functionality in the AEM product.

Development of an online application for services, including a portal used by customers to access the application, storage and transmittal of application data, and integration into the SEMS application.
Work with DCS staff to transfer the knowledge necessary to establish more forms in the online interface.
Training for DCS IT staff on the use of AEM in the identified areas (Central Pro replacement, XFT conversion, online application for services).

Work with DCS staff to develop requirements and design, develop a work plan and contribute to project artifacts maintained by the DCS Project Manager, software implementation, documentation and training.

notes: Attachments A (Sample Contract), B (Sample Bid Submission Letter), C (Bidder Certifications and Assurances) and D (Bidder Response Form) are not in this file. Attachment D is posted separately in Word and holds the actual scored questions and their points, the administrative questions and the pricing questions; this list is built from the solicitation's requirements, not from those questions.
Section D.5 also mentions an Attachment E, which is not in the RFP's own attachment list.

The text extraction dropped the automatic section numbers. Refs use the section letter, the heading's position (A.3 Project Scope, A.4 Deliverables, A.5 Bidder Minimum Qualifications and so on) and the letters as printed; numbers for Sections C to G are counted from the headings and may differ by one from the PDF.
The RFP's internal cross-references do not match its printed letters: it cites Design/Setup as 3.c, Develop/Integration as 3.d and training as 3.f, but those subsections are printed as g, h and j.

Section A.4 Deliverables largely restates Section A.3 scope as finished deliverables; both are listed, so many items come in pairs (for example A.3.h(14) and A.4.c(6)). 'Two prefill services for adaptive forms' (A.4.c(7)) appears only in the deliverables.
Repeats inside the scope: replacing the SEMS forms generation front end is in both A.3.g(2)(j) and A.3.h(24); the online application for services is in A.1.d, A.3.c, A.3.h(28) and A.4.c(9).

Likely typos in the RFP: 'SDP templates' in A.4.c(8) where the scope says XDP; about 300 XFT files to convert, but the Background says approximately 3500 form templates and the scope says up to 1,500 XDP templates; the points table says 'one thousand for hundred (1,400)'.

Training asks reach beyond AEM Forms: AEM Sites authoring and a DITA CCMS editor (A.3.j(2)), AEM Workbench and JEE applications (A.3.j(4)(a)). Archival storage is called SQL storage in one place (A.3.g(3)) and Azure/Cosmos in others.
The solicitation schedule skips items 3 and 4. The contract dates are 2021 to 2023.
